description: Read a wallet's native and (optionally) ERC-20 balances across multiple chains at once. Pass tokensByChain (chainId -> token addresses) to include token balances; omit chainIds to scan every chain with a public RPC (max 13 chains, and at most 100 token reads total across all chains). Per-chain RPC failures are returned inline so one dead endpoint does not sink the result. Read-only; holds no keys.

chainIds.description: Chains to read (max 13). Omit to scan all chains with a public RPC.

tokensByChain.description: Map of chainId -> ERC-20 token addresses to read on that chain (native is always included).

name: get_portfolio
